BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 534,794 of its own ordinary shares between May 18th and May 22nd, 2026, with prices ranging from 67.00 pence to 71.90 pence per share. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of outstanding ordinary shares to 344,462,423, which will be used by shareholders for disclosure calculations under the FCA's rules. The company's total issued ordinary share capital currently stands at 349,732,117 shares. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 26 May 2026 26 May 2026 'Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 18 May 2026 19 May 2026 20 May 2026 21 May 2026 22 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 115,161 128,736 147,231 52,407 91,201 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 69.00 70.90 70.70 71.70 71.90 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 67.00 68.10 69.20 70.60 71.00 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 68.3567 69.9788 69.7097 71.0537 71.3800 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 349,732,117 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 5,269,694 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 344,462,423 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
